SetFunctionValue (($ fX) + " " + ($ fY) + " " + ($ fZ) + " " + ($ fI) + " " + ($ fJ) + " " + ($ fK) + " " + ($ fA) + " " + ($ fT) + " " + ($ fB) + " " + ($ fC) + " " + ($ fH))
